metadata.description: Bastar is said to be mysterious land with dense forests, sarpin valleys and rivers. In Bastar, Kanger Valley National Park has three exceptional caves, the Kailash cave is the oldest cave in this area. In the underground caves of Bastar, the Kailash Cave has the earliest limestone formations which are very attractive. Bastar is also famous for it's Dhokra art.
